body.description: IP rule lists to apply, by category.

adminAllowedIpRules.description: Addresses allowed to reach the cluster's admin endpoints. Replaces the existing admin-allow list entirely; omit to leave it unchanged.

address.description: IPv4 address or CIDR block, e.g. `203.0.113.4/32`.

realmAllowedIpRules.description: Addresses allowed to reach the cluster's realm endpoints. Replaces the existing realm-allow list entirely; omit to leave it unchanged.

address.description: IPv4 address or CIDR block, e.g. `203.0.113.4/32`.

realmBlockedIpRules.description: Addresses blocked from reaching the cluster's realm endpoints. Replaces the existing realm-block list entirely; omit to leave it unchanged.

address.description: IPv4 address or CIDR block, e.g. `203.0.113.4/32`.
